notes.title: Version 1.5
notes.notes:
Functions:
   - Dualshock 4 support added
   - Command input system has been redesigned

Gameplay Changes:
   - Improved vehicle stability
   - Collectible items have been redistributed for smoother gameplay
   - Scenarios have been adjusted for smoother gameplay

notes.title: Version 1.4
notes.notes:
[b]Gameplay Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Now the game starts with 7  vehicles (lives).
[*] Collecting all the golden stars in a level will grant an extra life.
[/list]

[b]Camera Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] The camera will be more stable when the vehicle flips.
[*] The camera will be more accurate overall.
[/list]

[b]Information:[/b]
[list]
[*] The pause menu will now provide more helpful tips in "Instructions" option.
[/list]
